c74object.name: evi_tanh
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_tanh.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_tanh.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_tanh.genexpr file also requires:
evi_approx.genexpr
About this File:
A collection of tanh() approximations because we use them so much. Approximations are faster than library functions but less accurate. You should be careful using approximations - they can break your code. In evieve all approximations are tested to work on the code in which they are used.

entry.name: tanhL ( )
entry.description:
High quality Lambert approx, 2x faster than library tanh(). Excellent mathematical and sonic closeness to library tanh(). In general we use this one most often.
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Tanh, Approximate tanh() of input

entry.name: tanhLxA ( )
entry.description:
Wrapper for tanhL(). Returns 'tanh(x / a) * a'
In 1: type=input: x, Input
In 2: type=input: a, ± linear gain, input div, output mul
Return 1: Tanh, Approximate tanh() of input wrapped by gain coefficient

entry.name: tanhO ( )
entry.description:
By fire-sledge (LdS), we use this for some of the Adaa methods in evieve, similar efficiency to 'tanhL()'
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Tanh, Approximate tanh() of input

entry.name: tanhA ( )
entry.description:
'Bright' tanh
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Tanh, Approximate tanh() of input

entry.name: tanhD ( )
entry.description:
'Dark' tanh, the cheapest of all the tanh approximations here
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Tanh, Very approximate tanh() of input

entry.name: tanhQ ( )
entry.description:
'Dull' tanh
In 1: type=input: x, Input
Return 1: Tanh, Approximate tanh() of input

entry.name: tanhR ( )
entry.description:
'Crap' tanh
In 1: type=input: x0, Input
Return 1: Tanh, Approximate tanh() of input

entry.name: tanhXdX ( )
entry.description:
Padé approximation for tanh(sqrt(x))/sqrt(x)
In 1: type=input: x, Input range -1..1
Return 1: TanhXdX, Approximate tanh(sqrt(x))/sqrt(x) of input

entry.name: altTanhAdaa1 ( )
entry.description:
First order anti-derivative anti-aliasing of an accurate tanh-like function
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input to saturate
In 2: type=input: reset, (Optional) reset state
Return 1: Tanh saturation, Anti-aliased tanh-like saturated output

entry.name: altTanhAdaa2 ( )
entry.description:
Second order anti-derivative anti-aliasing of an accurate tanh-like function
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input to saturate
In 2: type=input: reset, (Optional) reset state
Return 1: Tanh saturation, Anti-aliased tanh-like saturated output
